{'text': 'CarPlay 版 Google Maps 喺導航期間加入咗 Gemini 功能，可以進行對話式駕駛體驗。', 'paragraph_context': 'Google Maps in CarPlay now lets you access Gemini when navigating for a conversational driving experience.'}

{'text': '使用導航時，點擊右側嘅 Gemini 圖示，就可以發問或者發出多步指令，例如：', 'paragraph_context': 'When using navigation, tapping the Gemini icon on the right edge lets you ask multi-step questions and issue commands like:'}

  • {'text': '「邊個公園以能夠飽覽全城靚景而聞名？」', 'paragraph_context': '“What park is famous for gorgeous views overlooking the city?”'}
  • {'text': '「我想去一個唔會太擠迫、天氣又好的時間，現在係唔係一個好時機？」', 'paragraph_context': '“I want to go at a time when it’s not too busy and the weather will stay nice. Is now a good time?”'}
  • {'text': '「幫我規劃去嗰度嘅路線，但要避開收費道路。」', 'paragraph_context': '“Start navigating me there but make sure to avoid toll roads.”'}

{'text': '今次係 Google Maps 首次喺 CarPlay 上面提供語音助手功能。之前，Google 助理只喺直接用 iPhone 開 Google Maps 導航嘅時候先用得。', 'paragraph_context': 'This is the first time Google Maps is offering voice assistant functionality in CarPlay. Previously, Google Assistant was only available when using Google Maps navigation directly on your iPhone.'}

{'text': 'Gemini 亦可以用語音回報交通受阻情況呢個同 Google Maps 去年喺 Android 同 iOS 推出嘅導航體驗一樣，而 Android Auto 平台早已經提供呢項功能。', 'paragraph_context': 'Gemini can also be used to report traffic disruptions with your voice. This matches the navigation experience introduced on Google Maps for Android and iOS last year, while it’s already available in Android Auto.'}

{'text': 'Gemini 喺 Apple CarPlay 版 Google Maps 而家已經喺美國推出，全球亦正在陸續擴展。', 'paragraph_context': 'Gemini in Google Maps on Apple CarPlay is available now in the US, while the global rollout is underway.'}

{'text': '更多 Google Maps 相關報導：', 'paragraph_context': 'More on Google Maps:'}

  • {'text': 'Google Maps 將你的座駕化身成 McLaren F1', 'paragraph_context': 'Google Maps now lets you turn your car into a McLaren F1'}
  • {'text': 'Google Maps 更新：Android Auto 會顯示下一個轉彎嘅交通燈同停車標誌仲有更多功能', 'paragraph_context': 'Google Maps update shows traffic lights and stop signs at your next turn on Android Auto, more'}
  • {'text': 'Google Maps「Ask Maps」推出 Personal Intelligence 實時交通資訊以及全球擴展', 'paragraph_context': 'Ask Maps in Google Maps rolling out Personal Intelligence, real-time transit, global launch'}
